messages:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding HF sentencepiece model `hf-foo/spm-large-v1`. After our HF->Redwood conversion (spm->bpe pipeline) the dev eval shows perplexity +12% and some hallucination regressions.
samir: Any quick diffs of tokenizer ids? config.json special tokens? sometimes pad/bos/unk get remapped.
maya: I dumped token ids for a few anchor strings and they don't match HF's tokenizer. Example diff (short):
```
HF: 'the' -> 5022
Our: 'the' -> 5024
HF: '<pad>' -> 0
Our: '<pad>' -> 2
```
jonathan: That smells like reserved id offset during spm->bpe. Do we preserve the original SentencePiece reserved ids? check `spm2bpe` flags — reserve_extra_ids? also NBSP/ZWJ pieces sometimes change merge ordering.
maya: We used the default spm2bpe flow. I ran a minimal repro script that shows merges containing U+202F (narrow no-break space) get stripped and following vocab entries shift index. Repro snippet: 
```
# repro: minimal
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
# load HF spm and our converted bpe
# compare token -> id for sample tokens
```
ml-qa-bot: eval-bot: nightly-eval for `hf-foo/spm-large-v1` -> BLEU -7pt, ppl +12% (regression flagged)
samir: If ids shifted, any downstream quant tables keyed by token id will be misaligned, so int8 experiments would definitely degrade quality. Check config.json fields: `pad_token_id`, `bos_token_id`, `eos_token_id`, and the `vocab_size` — an off-by-n there explains the shift.
maya: Good call. I inspected config.json: `vocab_size` equals HF vocab size minus 3 (we apparently dropped 3 merge entries that started with special whitespace). Our converter pruned them silently.
jonathan: Fix options: 1) keep all original SPM pieces (including NBSP/ZWJ) in conversion; 2) reserve the first N ids for special tokens and ensure we insert placeholders rather than deleting; 3) or remap quant tables by token *string* instead of id.
maya: I'm going to patch spm2bpe to preserve exact piece ordering and to explicitly write a `special_tokens_map` to config.json so IDs are pinned. I'll add a unit test that compares token->id mapping against HF reference for 1k samples.
maya: Patch preview: 
```
# spm2bpe change: preserve ordering, no silent prune
convert_spm(vocab, keep_whitespace=True)
write_config({'pad_token_id': 0, 'unk_token_id': 1, 'bos_token_id': 2})
```
ops-bot: deploy-candidate maya/spm-fix -> staging started :rocket:
samir: Once in staging run full eval and also run the quantized (int8) smoke tests.
ml-qa-bot: full-eval (staging): BLEU +6pt vs broken build; ppl delta now within -0.4% of HF baseline. Regression resolved.
maya: Nice — fix confirmed. I'll open a small RFC to make token-string-based quant mapping the default for future conversions.
jonathan: Also add a lint in onboarding checklist: compare sample token->id parity with HF and fail conversion on mismatch (unless explicit remap requested).
maya: Will do. Thanks all.
